title: The Venomous Supper Club
story: On a chilly evening, four esteemed guests were invited to attend a dinner party at the lavish mansion of the enigmatic Professor Poison. The esteemed guests were Dr. Venom, Sir Nox, Miss Poisonous, and Master Toxin. As they gathered to enjoy a sumptuous meal prepared by the culinary maestro, Master Toxin, an unfortunate event occurred that would change the course of the night. The professor disappeared without a trace, leaving the guests to find him before it was too late.
crimeScene: A luxurious mansion with an opulent dining room.
forensicClue: A peculiar label on the poisoned dish reads 'Precious Poisonous Mushroom - Do Not Disturb', a phrase that seems to suggest the culprit wanted to prevent interference.
question: Who is the culprit and how did they poison the dish?
options: Option D (Master Toxin and incriminating clue)
